title: Commitment onboarding checklist and invoice reconciliation flow
creator: Arielle Park
description: Create a lightweight but enforceable process for new customer commitment offers (reserved capacity, credit commitments, marketplace allocations) that covers intake, prioritization, customer onboarding checklist, and a reproducible invoice reconciliation flow. This ticket bundles the operational playbook, required artifacts, routing rules, and two automations to reduce manual handoffs between PM, Sales Ops, Finance, and Customer Success.
intake_form_fields: Primary AE / SDR / Customer Success contact
Type of request: Commitment | Marketplace credit | Invoicing exception | Allocation change
Requested contract term and start date
Commitment size (units/month or $) and expected consumption profile
Requested billing cadence (monthly/quarterly/annual) and invoicing PO details
If marketplace: partner & listing reference, credit percentage/units, and settlement flow
Attachments: signed term sheet, SOW, electronic PO, security/compliance exceptions
Customer stated reason/goal for request (free text)
Deadline or event driving the request (e.g., procurement window)
triage_rubric: Score factors (0-3 each): Revenue impact, Legal/Contract complexity, Accounting/Tax risk, Implementation effort, SLA or latency requirement
Weighting: Revenue 35%, Legal/Contract 20%, Accounting risk 15%, Implementation 20%, SLA 10%
Interpretation: Score >= 9 -> Escalate to Finance + Legal for custom terms; 6-8 -> PM review & Sales Ops; <=5 -> Standard Offer lane (self-serve or minor PR)
Priority bump rules: deadlines < 7 days or procurement-window-trigger -> automatic P0 review; security/compliance exception -> route to Security review immediately
Marketplace credit special-case: require partner legal template and mapping to settlement code before approval
routing_rules: Requests with revenue impact > $100k ARR or multi-region commitments -> Finance + Legal + Revenue Ops
Requests citing custom tax or invoicing requirements (VAT/tax-id, cross-border billing) -> Finance (AP/AR) & Tax specialist
Requests with compliance exemptions (SOC2, HIPAA) referenced -> Security & Compliance team
All other requests -> Sales Ops (first-touch) and PM for product feasibility
If intake form is incomplete -> automated follow-up to AE with checklist items (2 business day SLA to reply)
acceptance_criteria: A canonical onboarding checklist exists for commitments and is accessible to Sales Ops and CSMs
An intake form (Zendesk/Google Form) is linked in AE playbook and required in Linear ticket submission
A documented triage rubric with threshold values in this ticket is adopted by PM and Finance for routing
Two automations implemented: (1) incomplete-intake reminder to AE, (2) Finance escalation for high-revenue requests
Sample invoice reconciliation checklist validated against 3 recent customer invoices and one marketplace settlement statement
At least one post-onboarding runbook for a major edge case (cross-entity invoicing) completed and reviewed by Finance
steps_for_invoice_reconciliation: Gather artifacts: signed commitment, monthly usage export, invoice PDF, payment receipts, marketplace settlement CSV
Normalize terms: confirm billing period, currency, taxes, and discounts applied on invoice match signed commitment
Map posted invoice line items to commitment buckets and marketplace codes (use standardized ledger mapping spreadsheet)
If discrepancy found: open a Finance ticket with reconciliation table and suggested adjustment; copy revenue ops and AE
If customer paid incorrect amount: route to AR for collection/credit; if overcharged, process credit memo and notify customer within 5 business days
Log reconciliation outcome in ticket and update customer billing profile (tags for future automation)
automation_playbook: Automation A: Intake completeness checker (runs on form submission). If required fields missing -> send templated request to AE, add label 'awaiting-intake', escalate to PM after 48 hours
Automation B: Revenue threshold splitter (on ticket creation). If commitment > threshold -> add 'finance-escalate' label and notify Finance Slack channel with ticket link
Automation C (future): Auto-fill invoice reconciliation template by ingesting monthly usage CSV and matching against contract terms (requires SRE/BI support)
Suggested tooling: use Salesforce + Zendesk + Linear integration for auto-sync; short-term implement with Google Forms + Zapier for rule triggers
stakeholder_matrix: AE: owns customer communication and supplies intake artifacts
CSM: coordinates onboarding and validates usage expectations
Sales Ops: first-triage, verifies PO and billing details
Finance (AR/AP): final approval for invoicing exceptions and credit memos
Legal: reviews non-standard contract language and marketplace partner agreements
PM: evaluates product/implementation feasibility and tracks product-side dependencies
Security & Compliance: reviews any data residency or compliance exceptions
sample_templates: AE follow-up (intake incomplete): Hi <AE name>, we received a pricing request for <customer>. Please attach the signed term sheet and confirm contract start date. Required fields missing: [list]. Reply within 48 hours or we will mark the ticket stale.

Customer-facing reconciliation acknowledgement: Hi <Customer>, we’re reviewing your invoice for <period>. We will confirm any adjustments within 5 business days and share the reconciliation table. Thank you for the artifacts you provided.
Finance escalation message: New commitment requires review — Customer <name>, commitment $<amount>, start <date>. Link to intake: <linear link>. Key risks: [list].
metrics_to_track: Time-to-first-response for pricing intake (target < 2 business days)
Time-to-final-decision for commitments (target < 10 business days for standard; < 3 business days for urgent)
% of intakes that are complete on first submission (target > 80%)
Invoice reconciliation lead time (target < 5 business days)
Number of post-invoice adjustments / month (trend downwards as process matures)
open_questions: What is the canonical revenue threshold for auto-escalation (proposal: $100k ARR)?
Should marketplace settlement mapping live in Finance's general ledger or a dedicated partner ledger?
How do we represent multi-entity billing where customer legal entity differs from the buying org?
Do we require legal review for all multi-year commitments > 24 months?
What level of automation for invoice reconciliation can be delivered in Q2 vs Q3?
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: Missing or inaccurate intake artifacts leading to delayed legal/finance review -> Mitigation: automated completeness check + AE SLA
Risk: Manual reconciliation causing repeated billing disputes -> Mitigation: build reconciliation template and prioritize automation for top 10 customers
Risk: Incorrect marketplace settlement mapping causing partner over/underpayments -> Mitigation: require partner legal template and a sample settlement CSV during intake
Risk: Cross-border tax issues delaying invoice issuance -> Mitigation: early routing to Tax specialist and inclusion of tax-id fields in intake
